featured_reviews.review_text: Was truly horrified with the kind of service here, when I took a friend's innova for a diesel wash and wheel balancing and alignment .. the entire process took about 6 hours, which I felt could be done in literally half the amount of time... I don't think I will go back there to get any work done...

featured_reviews.review_text:
Not at all recommended. I had opted out for a Full detail which costed me around 3.5k for both Interior & Exterior. At this price if you're expecting an attention to detail, then this is not the right place. The labourers just want to get their work done and leave.

Exterior: Compounding & the machine usage was all satisfactory wherein I can still find swirls on my car. Later when, wax which was applied all over plastic parts & tyres didn't even stay for a day's time. It's the same story with engine bay as well.

Interior: Their website says they use branded products to get rid of all dirt & dust particles but it was all opposite. The wax which they applied on my dashboard didn't even stay for a week's time. Without touching the headliner these guys were about to leave. After pointing it out, they just carried out the job just for the sake of it and they left onto which I had to recall them again because it was an shoddy job. Pedals were left as it is.

Totally disappointed. Lessons learnt.

featured_reviews.name: JASPREET BHAMRA
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently took my car to Samarth Car Polish & Detailing Center, owned by Roshan Shejwal, and I was extremely  happy with the results. The wash and polish were absolutely fantastic, and the level of care and attention to detail was truly impressive.
Roshan treated my car as if it were his own, meticulously cleaning every surface and ensuring the finish was perfect. The detailing work was thorough, and it's clear he takes immense pride in his craft.
For anyone looking for a top-quality polish, I highly recommend this place. Forget the fancy, glamorous detailing centers—Samarth Car Polish & Detailing Center offers superior service and results that speak for themselves. You get genuine, expert care without the high-end price tag.

featured_reviews.name: Akshay
featured_reviews.review_text:
On May 26th, I had my car detailed both inside and out by this gentleman. He put in a considerable amount of effort, spending over 4 hours to complete the wash, which was truly commendable. Moreover, his service is very affordable, and the fact that he offers a doorstep service is quite convenient, provided you have access to water and electricity in your area.

He managed to remove some tough, deep marks from my car, which was impressive. However, there were still some paint marks on certain body panels that weren't completely removed, and the underside of the car didn't receive as much attention as I would have liked. Additionally, the cleaning materials didn't seem to be from top-notch brands, but considering the price, I suppose that's understandable.

The interior polish was satisfactory, but I was a bit disappointed that the interior roof wasn't cleaned at all. Also, there were some debris left under the seats, indicating that the cleaning could have been more thorough.

Overall, I would say it's worth giving his service a try, especially considering the affordability and the effort he puts in. However, there is definitely room for improvement, particularly in addressing the points mentioned above. If he can address these areas, I would have no hesitation in recommending his service.
